text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Even though my Trainer went out of their way to invite me out the other day...
I ended up causing nothing but trouble...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...My faint presence, the way I eat.
I always knew about them, but I never tried to fix them.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I cannot allow... something like that to happen again...
I have to do something...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Mmh, gulp... *nom* *nom*...

—Noon. Heading into the cafeteria, my eyes met
Still in Love's—who was frantically shoveling food into her mouth.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ngh! *cough*, *cough*...!

The next moment, Still in Love began to choke.
I hurried over to rub her back and calm her down.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... phew...
...Trainer... for you to see me like this, how embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I'm alright now.
I'm sorry for startling you...

Why would someone who normally eats so slowly do that...?
Puzzled, I asked her for the reason. To which she replied—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Um. T-There is no deep meaning behind it. Think of it as a shift in mindset,
so to speak... I simply thought... I might try changing myself.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: This is merely one step in that direction...

Setting personal growth aside, there surely was no need to force a change to her eating pace.
Eating slowly was vastly better than wolfing it down anyway.
choice_data_list: I think eating at your own pace is just fine.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ...
Still... I would like to try just once more.

From the look of it, she seemed to have other reasons for wanting to change.
Without pressing further, I decided to keep her company, but—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... I truly thought... I was going to choke...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry... for making you worry...
...I'm so glad you were here to help, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I tried copying Oguri-san, but...
things didn't quite go as planned...

With her cheeks stuffed full she had looked rather like a chipmunk—quite adorable, actually—
but pushing herself was no good. I spoke to her gently as she hung her head.
choice_data_list: Food is meant to be enjoyed, after all.

text_block_list.text:
With that, I began eating my own meal.
Taking it slow, matching Still in Love's usual leisurely pace.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
... ...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Changing my eating speed proved too difficult, so next...
I will work on my faint presence... I want people to actually notice me...!
choice_data_list: What do you plan to do, specifically?
What do you plan to do, specifically?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
A-Anyway... I will try calling out to people.
Not from behind, but directly from the front—and c-cheerfully!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, um...! May I have just a moment—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Man, I've been running nonstop since this morning!
Though I'm heading out for another run right now... Alright, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
H-Hmph. ...*ahem*.
E-Excuse me! Do you have a moment...!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Did somebody just call my name?
There's nobody around, though... Guess it was just my imagination.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I-It wasn't your imagination—... Ah...

We tested it with quite a few Umamusume, but none seemed to notice her
merely from hearing her voice. It was as though she were veiled in thick mist.

It wasn't that she made no footsteps, nor was her appearance unremarkable.
Even so, most people failed to sense her presence.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...To think they only notice after I step directly in front of them and block the path...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Would it be different... if it were *her*...?
...Ah... but then, there would be no point...
choice_data_list: People don't easily notice unless they're actively looking.

text_block_list.text:
I peered gently into her face, placing each of us squarely in the other's view.
As if to reassure her that everything was alright.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...You're comforting me, aren't you...?
Just how much kindness... can you possibly hold...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, ...
I must not let myself depend entirely on that kindness...)
—The next day.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...
...*My* Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I'm so sorry.
I tried stepping forward as much as I could to stay in your sight, but...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I seem to have ended up... standing closer than intended...
...I startled you, didn't I?
choice_data_list: N-No, I'm the one who should apologize!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Please, don't apologize.
The one at fault... is me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Um. Don't you... come to resent it?
Being around me... doesn't it tire you out...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
But if things continue like this...
I fear it will become... an emotional burden on you, Trainer...
Still in Love casts her eyes downward, looking apologetic.

—Could the true meaning behind her wanting to change herself
simply be because she thinks she's becoming a burden?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes?
choice_data_list: I think of your surprises as gifts from you.
I think of your surprises as gifts from you.

text_block_list.text:
So don't worry, and there's no need to fret over it.
Because after the initial surprise, I genuinely feel happy.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ahh... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...To think you would accept me like that...
I...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I want to, too.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(It feels as comforting as soaking in warm water.
An absolute trust that as long as I am with you, everything will be all right.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(However... I cannot simply keep receiving.
If you accept me just the way I am...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (Then I want to accept you, too. Every single part of you, just as you are.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Even if... no matter what form that might take.
